response.rationale: Both forms denote the official registration of a road vehicle. Indonesian commonly uses “registrasi kendaraan,” while Malaysian Malay prefers “pendaftaran kenderaan,” making this a useful everyday contrast.
response.risk_rationale: Indonesian learners may also encounter “pendaftaran kendaraan,” so the contrast is preferential rather than exclusive.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Pendaftaran kendaraan” is also ordinary in Indonesian, but “registrasi kendaraan” remains a credible Indonesian preference; the proposed pair still teaches a useful national usage contrast.
